headline: Wardens Gain Two Posts in Weathered Expanse as Palantine Berm Blazes
war_summary: Three hours have shifted the map once more. In the Weathered Expanse, the day's most active field with fifty-eight recorded actions, the Wardens now hold four of nine posts to the Colonials' two, three lying in ruins; Crow's Nest and Wightwalk remain the busiest grounds, and the newest action was logged at press time itself. Palantine Berm burns hotter still — ten actions in two hours about The Droll and Leiri Hermanni, two-hour losses approaching two hundred a side, the Warden edge at four posts to three. Stlican Shelf's churn about Briar continues, one post now in ruins between seven Colonial holdings and one Warden. Callahan's Passage, the day's bloodiest field with some twenty-five thousand casualties across thirty-five actions at Crumbling Post, has gone quiet these past two hours, its line still eight Warden posts to two Colonial. The Nevish Line, too, has fallen quiet these two hours after twenty actions at Blinding Stones and Grief Mother. Linn of Mercy, wholly Colonial-held, records no post changes yet runs heavy Warden losses. Stonecradle's activity about The Reach persists. Elsewhere the front lies still on this 511th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
